title: The specified linear compact-support action and its Cartesian geometry
statement: The concrete linear coordinate map, canonical Tate coefficient descent, bounded-below tower comparison, and exchange action used by affineSpaceLinearTraceInvariance are the definitions of [lem-amb-linear-trace-invariance], moved without changing their bodies or types. The linear coordinate map is an automorphism and has a Cartesian square over the identity. The tower map is Cartesian over every change of base, and the linear maps commute with pullback of their matrix entries.

proof.text: For the geometric certificate, compare coordinate pullbacks, prove the composition formula a_g followed by a_h equals a_(hg), and a_1=id. The inverse is a_(g inverse). Apply IsPullback.of_horiz_isIso to its structure-map equality.

source.place: Proof paragraphs 1–2; isolated part of the scalar argument

proof.text: Induct through affine-line base change squares and paste vertically. Pullback preserves each coordinate, by induction using the affine-space coordinate equations. Compare the matrix-vector coordinate sums to obtain naturality of the linear map.
